role: satisfiable / valid / finitely satisfiable / infinity-axiom / unsatisfiable members of a class X of sentences
notes: Source notation of Boerger-Graedel-Gurevich 1997, Def. 2.1.27 (p. 33); X a class of formulas, X = FO written without argument, main case X = Sent(L) for a finite relational signature L. Values are sets of formula codes.

role: run signature of a Turing machine T
notes: Binary <, Hd, Cl_a (a a tape symbol); unary St_q (q a state).

role: relation symbol of the run signature: state at a moment
notes: Object-language relation symbols; St_q unary, Hd and Cl_a binary.

role: relation symbol of the run signature: head cell at a moment
notes: Object-language relation symbols; St_q unary, Hd and Cl_a binary.

role: relation symbol of the run signature: cell content at a moment
notes: Object-language relation symbols; St_q unary, Hd and Cl_a binary.

role: defined formula abbreviation: immediate successor
notes: Abbreviations of first-order formulas in the run signature; not new symbols of the signature.

role: defined formula abbreviation: least element
notes: Abbreviations of first-order formulas in the run signature; not new symbols of the signature.

role: defined formula abbreviation: head move in direction d
notes: Abbreviations of first-order formulas in the run signature; not new symbols of the signature.

role: defined formula abbreviation: initial tape for input w
notes: Abbreviations of first-order formulas in the run signature; not new symbols of the signature.

role: run sentence of machine T on input word w
notes: A sentence of the run signature; has a finite model iff T reaches its accepting state on w.

role: path formula of index j in the single binary relation E
notes: Formula abbreviation: there is a path of exactly j unlooped vertices from x to y. Scoped to the path translation; the global pi rows (proof code, projections, paths of transition structures) have other roles.

role: path translation of a formula and of a sentence into the signature {E}
notes: Postfix syntactic operations; varphi-sharp adds the conjunct that some vertex is looped.

role: decoded structure of a graph with a loop
notes: Operations on structures; D(G(M)) = M (Lemma thm:p02-w02-p02-036-gadget).

role: path graph of a structure
notes: Operations on structures; D(G(M)) = M (Lemma thm:p02-w02-p02-036-gadget).

role: auxiliary vertex number i of the path for a fact f
notes: Fresh vertices of the path graph; unlooped.

role: renaming of the relation symbol E to R in a sentence
notes: Symbol renaming, not term substitution; the global [t/x] row is capture-avoiding term substitution.

role: Fagin's word encoding of a finite structure and the set of encodings of a class
notes: Source notation of Fagin 1974 pp. 52-53; universe {1,...,n}; same notation as the P9 presentation sec:p09-presentation-n-c-004.

role: Fagin's class of sets recognized nondeterministically in exponential time
notes: Source notation of Fagin 1974 p. 51; also used in sec:p09-presentation-n-c-004.

role: the source's infinity axiom in one binary relation symbol K
notes: Source notation of Boerger-Graedel-Gurevich 1997 p. 33: forall x exists u forall y (not Kxx and Kxu and (Kyx -> Kyu)). A sentence name; prec is not used here as an order symbol.

role: disjoint sets of natural numbers in the definition of recursive inseparability
notes: Bound letters of the source definition (BGG Def. 2.1.28); in proofs a separating set is written W.

role: recursive set separating X from Y in the definition of recursive inseparability
notes: Bound letters of the source definition (BGG Def. 2.1.28); in proofs a separating set is written W.

role: set of valid program codes
notes: Program codes of sec:universal-reductions-01; M_e is a Turing machine tuple, not a structure.

role: machine decoded from a valid code e
notes: Program codes of sec:universal-reductions-01; M_e is a Turing machine tuple, not a structure.

role: codes of machines that reject / accept / never halt on the empty input
notes: Source notation of BGG p. 34 (H_1, H_2 and the non-halting set); the rejecting state plays the source stop state 1, the accepting state stop state 2. Sets of natural numbers; distinct from the binary relation symbol H of the reduction formula.

role: signature of the refined reduction formula of a machine M
notes: Binary K, S, H, T_a; unary Z, I_q.

role: relation symbols of the reduction formula: order, successor, head position, tape letter, state, zero
notes: Source notation of BGG pp. 20-22 (H, T_j, I_i, S, K) with Z for the source constant 0 (as in BGG Exercise 2.1.31). Object-language relation symbols; K here is unrelated to the self-application set K of sec:universal-reductions-03.

role: abbreviation: the disjunction of I_q(x) over non-halting states q
notes: Formula abbreviation, not a symbol of the signature.

role: named conjuncts of the reduction formula
notes: Source names (BGG pp. 20-22); ORDER^- is the source ORDER without its successor-existence clause.

role: relativized infinity axiom of a machine M
notes: Name from BGG p. 35; the relational formula here asserts S-successors for active moments and visited cells and S-predecessors for visited cells.

role: refined reduction formula of M
notes: Source notation rho_{M,prec} (BGG p. 34); sentences. The global rho row is a substitution metavariable; this is a named sentence in a scoped definition.

role: variant of the refined reduction formula of M with unrestricted successors
notes: Source notation rho_{M,prec} (BGG p. 34); sentences. The global rho row is a substitution metavariable; this is a named sentence in a scoped definition.

role: configuration at step t with tape inscription B_t
notes: B_t replaces the configuration letter T of sec:turing-machines-01 to avoid a clash with the relation symbols T_a.

role: time element of a model
notes: B_t replaces the configuration letter T of sec:turing-machines-01 to avoid a clash with the relation symbols T_a.

role: cell element of a model
notes: B_t replaces the configuration letter T of sec:turing-machines-01 to avoid a clash with the relation symbols T_a.

role: existential closure of a formula
notes: Postfix syntactic operation, local to the proof in the annex.
